title: Heritage Short storyboard
description: The contract between every pipeline stage. Every stage reads this file; nothing about the film is hidden in code.

notes.description: Free text for humans. Ignored by the pipeline.

logline.description: One sentence that sums up the story.

intent.description: What the audience should feel or understand at the end.

narration.description: ISO 639 code, e.g. am, om, ti, so, en

style_block.description: Fixed look description appended to every image prompt (palette, light, medium). Describe qualities, not living artists.

style.description: Default delivery instruction for every line, e.g. calm, warm, unhurried. Never spoken.

style_mode.description: How style reaches the TTS model: the SDK's speech_metadata field, a text prefix, or not at all.

language_code.description: Passed to TTS, e.g. am or am-ET.

pronunciations.description: Written word -> spelling given to the TTS model so it is pronounced right (whole words only). Changes only the spoken audio: the written line and the subtitles stay as they are. Each entry should be backed by a listener's note (DESIGN.md) and an experiment.

mode.description: per_line: one TTS call per shot (cheap single-line retakes). continuous: the whole narration in ONE call (one voice and flow throughout), split at pauses into per-shot segments. Per-line style overrides are ignored in continuous mode.

image.description: Keyframe generation. One square master per shot, cropped to 16:9 and 9:16 in assembly (subjects are centred).

reference_sheets.description: One reference sheet per character; every shot of that character is conditioned on it (if the model supports references).

score.description: Music generated on Kaggle (ACE-Step) from music_cues, then trimmed to the film length.

chosen.description: Which candidate is used in the film (null = placeholder pad).

text.description: Must say the film was made with AI.

description.description: Same wording every time, so the look does not drift.

reference_image.description: Path to the approved reference sheet image, once generated.

consent_ref.description: Where consent is recorded, e.g. ETHICS.md#grandmother, or 'fictional' for an invented person.

reason.description: Why this shot exists, in one sentence.

motion_prompt.description: Only motion and camera; the keyframe already holds the subject.

beats.description: More pictures inside this shot, each starting at the word it shows (pipeline/beats.py). The shot's own image is beat 0.

from_word.description: Index of the narration word (0-based, split on spaces) this picture lands on.

text.description: ONLY the words to be spoken, in the film's language. No stage directions. Empty string = silent shot.

focus.description: Point of interest (x, y as fractions of the keyframe) that the 16:9 / 9:16 crops and the Ken Burns move centre on. Default [0.5, 0.5].

still.description: Ken Burns on another shot's keyframe (an insert from the same scene), e.g. after 3 failed takes of this shot's own keyframe.

appearance.description: Character id -> a full description used instead of the character's own for this shot/beat only (e.g. swimming in shorts).

box.description: x0, y0, x1, y1 as fractions of the keyframe: the region (heads, faces, key action) that must stay inside every crop and every Ken Burns move.

speech_metadata.description: Delivery and timing cues, kept apart from the spoken text.

style.description: Overrides voice.style for this line. Affects the audio (part of the narration hash).

pause_before_s.description: Silence before the line starts. Edit-only: no new TTS call.

pause_after_s.description: Minimum silence after the line. Edit-only: no new TTS call.

caption.description: Style, mood, instruments, texture. Tempo and key go in their own fields.
